limits: Research only. Paired controls retrain MiniLM heads on money-redacted descriptions; current deployment is a historical reference and includes an additional validation calibration. Each arm uses identical retained Lemon rows, five group OOF folds, training-only 32-dimensional cosine UMAP for BGE (30 neighbours, min_dist 0.1, seed 42), AFT and robust Bayesian likelihood selection. Retained-cohort CV is conditional on earlier cleaning; historical test has been examined before. No claim of current-market validation or serving readiness.
